# Forward It

> A small card shop in Kelowna, British Columbia, selling letterpress thank-you cards and pay-it-forward note sets on cotton paper, posted within Canada.

- Single letterpress card: C$7
- Note set of 6: C$24
- Boxed set of 8: C$32
- Boxed set of 12: C$44
- Envelope pack of 10: C$8

Mail: cards@forwarditcharity.com
Not offered: custom printing, shipping outside Canada, digital cards, wholesale under 50 cards.
